items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Because I went with Pete's band and stayed there until he broke up.

ctx.x: But then when you were in the Saturday Night Swing Club on CBS, you still did the NBC Fred Allen? Peter Van Steeden?
Peter Van Steeden, yes. Because I went with Pete's band and stayed there until he broke up.
How late is that? I don't recall. How long was it?
